**Finding: missing (critical) — no IP/data ownership article.**

I read the entire agreement (a single-article Kubient/AP Master Services Agreement, ¶¶ p0000–p0074). There is no intellectual property or ownership section at all. The only proprietary-rights touchpoints are incidental:

- **p0025** (§6(a)) — Customer is "responsible and solely liable for all the Content (including … all intellectual property rights therein)" — a liability allocation, not an ownership grant.
- **p0043** (§9(c)(i)) — a Customer *warranty* that it owns the Content and Properties, running to Kubient's benefit.
- **p0039–p0040** (§9(b)) — Kubient warranties that it owns the Service/Auction Platform "and products delivered hereunder."
- **p0065** (§14(b)) — covers names, trademarks and logos only.
- **p0011** — "Requests" (data Customer sends to Kubient) is defined but its ownership is never addressed.

Direction check: nothing assigns our IP or data to Kubient, and no joint ownership is created, so this is not walk-away territory. But nothing reaches even the fallback — no Customer Data ownership statement, no ownership of or licence to deliverables created for us, and §9(b)(viii) arguably points "products delivered hereunder" toward Kubient with no licence back beyond the revocable, non-sublicensable platform licence in p0002 (which is expressly revoked on termination per p0021).

**Redline (validated ok:true):** a new Section 14 inserted after the Disclaimer (p0062) that (a) confirms we retain all rights in Content, Properties, Inventory, Requests and other Customer Data, with Kubient's use limited to providing the Services; (b) expressly preserves Kubient's ownership of the Auction Platform and background technology (its platform IP is untouched); (c) assigns bespoke deliverables and work product to us with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to any embedded Kubient materials; and (d) bars joint ownership. The comment offers the fallback (Kubient ownership of generic tools plus the perpetual licence) if Kubient resists assignment.
